app_release_notes: v1.11.0 - Shot the rest of your ladder on a second range day? Import the new rungs into the same load and they are added to it, with your first day kept and the whole ladder scored together. Score your ladder at any distance out to 1500 yards. ShotMarker groups import in the order they were fired. Angular figures use the distance recorded on your targets. Plus fixes to staged files, the Measure distance, and CBTO decimals.

windows.app_release_notes: v1.10.0 - Measure your targets in inches, MOA or mil. Factory ammo is now a load you can save and compare. Loadscope reopens at the size you left it. Plus fixes to seating-depth tests: the powder charge now shows on the printed cards, DOPE works on a seating-only load, and a CBTO ladder no longer reads as a jump.
